findings.message: `chupaRun` is computed as `available(r["runnable"] and not r["held"])`. The ticket's rule is exactly "`chupaRun`: `off` unless `runnable`; then `locked` when the engine is alive, else `on`." A row's `runnable` (observe.py:549) does not exclude held stems. So a held, confirmed ticket whose dependencies are met now gets `off` where the rule gives `on` (no engine) or `locked` (engine alive). The old menu enabled Run for it (`chupaRunnable && !chupaEngine`), and `chupa run` has no held refusal that would justify the extra condition. The test's held row is confirmed with no `depends`, so it is runnable, and its `chupaRun == 'off'` assertion passes only because of this unrequested condition.
findings.paved_road: Use `available(r["runnable"])` as the ticket specifies. In `test_snapshot_menu_availability`, make the held row non-runnable (for example, give it a `depends` on a stem that has not merged) so `chupaRun` is `off` because of `runnable`. If held tickets really must not be runnable from the menu, file that as a Suggestion Box item instead of adding it here.
